content.title: Rangers vs. Phillies: Prediction, Lineups, How to Watch (3/26/26)
content.text: The Texas Rangers head to the City of Brotherly Love this afternoon for an interleague Opening Day matchup against the Philadelphia Phillies at Citizens Bank Park. Nate Eovaldi — or “Nasty Nate” as the fans like to call him — takes the mound for Texas. Eovaldi went 11–3 with a 1.73 ERA last season, despite his year being limited by rotator cuff and elbow injuries. He struck out 129 batters over 130 innings in an elite, if shortened, campaign. The Rangers made a major move this offseason, acquiring MacKenzie Gore in a prospect-heavy deal, but questions remain about the offense. Texas finished in the bottom four in the American League in both home runs and batting average last season. The lineup shuffle included swapping Marcus Semien for Brandon Nimmo — a move aimed at adding power — while the club will also rely on a healthy Corey Seager to return to 30-plus home run form. Left-hander Cristopher Sánchez gets the ball for Philadelphia, coming off a career year in 2025. He went 13–5 with a 2.50 ERA, striking out 212 over 202 innings — a durable workhorse for the Phillies rotation. Behind him is one of the most dangerous lineups in the National League that returns from a 96-win season. The Phillies enter 2026 looking to build on a strong 2025 campaign, powered by a deep, slugging core anchored by Bryce Harper and Kyle Schwarber, who comes off a 56-homer season. Expect an Opening Day win for the Phillies behind Sánchez’s dominance on the mound and a power-driven lineup built to generate early offense. Prediction: Philadelphia Phillies 6, Texas Rangers 3 Starting Lineups Texas Rangers Brandon Nimmo — RF Wyatt Langford — CF Corey Seager — SS Jake Burger — 1B Andrew McCutchen — DH Josh Jung — 3B Josh Smith — 2B Danny Jansen — C Sam Haggerty — LF Starting Pitcher: Nathan Eovaldi — RHP Philadelphia Phillies Trea Turner — SS Kyle Schwarber — DH Bryce Harper — 1B Alec Bohm — 3B Bryson Stott — 2B Adolis García — RF Brandon Marsh — LF J.T. Realmuto — C Justin Crawford — CF Starting Pitcher: Cristopher Sánchez — LHP How to Watch Rangers vs. Phillies First pitch is scheduled for 4:15 PM Eastern / 3:15 PM Central at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia. The game airs live locally on NBC 10 and NBC Sports Philadelphia Plus, and the Rangers Sports Network. Out-of-market viewers can stream the game on MLB.TV.
